خَوْخَةٌ : see above. ＝
-A2- Also An aperture (S, A, Mgh, K) in a wall, (S, A, Mgh,) admitting the light (S, A, K) to a house, or chamber. (K.) ―
-b2- A passage (مُخْتَرَقٌ) between any two houses, not having a door, or gate: (K:) of the dial. of El-Hijáz; (TA;) [and of Egypt, where it is applied to a lane leading from one street or quarter to another: coll. gen. n. ↓ خَوْخٌ :] accord. to some, a passage (مُخْتَرَقٌ) between any two things: and a small door-way between two houses, or chambers, with a door affixed to it. (L.) ―
-b3- A wicket, or small door, (A, Mgh,) in a large door. (A.) [Golius, as on the authority of Meyd, explains it as meaning Fenestella in medio januæ.] ―
-b4- [Also applied to A sluice in a rivulet: see دَرَقَةٌ.] ―
-b5- (tropical:) The anus; syn. دُبُرٌ. (K, TA.) ＝
-A3- A kind of green garment: (Az, K:) of the dial. of Mekkeh. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
